Research REAL production systems that implement hybrid strict/free control in LLMs. I need to find: 1) Any existing frameworks that let users mark parts of output as constrained vs free 2) How production guardrail systems actually handle mixed constraints 3) Case studies of systems that tried 'prompt markers' and what the results were 4) The closest thing to 'partial constrained decoding' in production 5) How agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) handle this — do they use modes, markers, or something else? 6) Any empirical comparisons of different control approaches in the same system. Focus on real deployments, not papers. Search the web.
